title: Legal evidence + owner adoption register
decision: Owner decision, 6 October 2026 (GS-LEGAL-001): no solicitor is commissioned at this stage; GS-O003's mandatory solicitor approval is replaced by an evidence-based review of each document against current UK legislation and official guidance, followed by explicit owner adoption. Nothing in this register claims solicitor review, certification or guaranteed enforceability.
rules: Only the owner moves a document to OWNER_ADOPTED, by recording ownerAdoptedOn (date) and ownerAdoptedVersion (the exact version adopted). No script sets either.
PUBLISHABLE requires OWNER_ADOPTED plus a passing check:legal:adoption run on the adopted version; ownerAdoptedVersion must equal the document's version.
scripts/migrate-production-cms.mjs admits a legal document to the production payload only at PUBLISHABLE.
stateRecord: 6 October 2026 (GS-LEGAL-001): all seven moved to OWNER_REVIEW_REQUIRED on Agent G's re-verification (research/GS-LEGAL-001/G-final-cross-check.md section 7). What remains is the owner decisions in research/GS-LEGAL-001/GS-LEGAL-001-RECORD.md section 7; the privacy policy carries three [OWNER DECISION] markers that block PUBLISHABLE.
